title: Open Values Synonym Registry v0.1
description: A list of everyday words people search with, each pointing to the category or tag it means, such as "pop" to the soda category. Conscious Consuming keeps it.

format.description: Always "ovs-synonym-registry". Tells a reader that this file maps everyday words to categories and tags.

version.description: The version of the synonym registry format this file follows, 0.1.

updated.description: The day the file was last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

synonyms.description: Words people search with, each mapped to the category or tag it means, such as "pop" to "ovs:cat/soda". Each target is written "ovs:cat/" or "ovs:tag/" followed by an id.
